title: Account Banned Dispute
question_for_arbitration: Wrongful termination of Emily Carter's Gen Chorus Voice account following a disputed third content incident, including failure to properly consider the circumstances of the alleged inadvertent upload and the claimant's appeal, resulting in loss of a $24,500 commercial opportunity.
other_relief: Reinstatement of Emily Carter's Gen Chorus Voice account and restoration of account access and associated Content, subject to any reasonable conditions the arbitrator considers appropriate.
arbitration_clause: This arbitration shall be administered by DecisionLayer.AI under its Foundational + Strict Contractual Ruleset, subject to the law of New York and the Federal Arbitration Act. The arbitration will be held online through DecisionLayer.ai. Both parties agree to resolve any claims relating to or arising out of these Terms or the Services through final and binding individual arbitration by a single arbitrator. Class arbitrations, class actions, private attorney general actions, and consolidation with other arbitrations are not allowed. The arbitrator may award relief only individually and only to the extent necessary to redress individual claims. The DecisionLayer rules will govern payment of all arbitration fees. Gen Chorus Voice will not seek its attorneys' fees and costs in arbitration unless the arbitrator determines that the claim is frivolous or brought for an improper purpose.
